message.content:
The value of $20 in British pounds depends on the current USD‑GBP exchange rate, which fluctuates throughout the day. As of the most recent market data (mid‑2026), the rate is roughly **1 USD ≈ 0.78 GBP**.

Using that rate:

\[
\$20 \times 0.78 \;=\; \text{£15.60}
\]

So, **$20 is approximately £15.60**.  

If you need a precise figure for a specific transaction, it’s best to check a real‑time currency converter or your bank’s exchange rate at the time of the transfer.
